contract:
PURPOSE: the same six steps on desktop, in vanilla JS, mirroring B12/B12-social behaviour and ONB_COPY strings character for character. Keep the custom cursor, the hyperdrive (OH:1447-1473) and the boot reader (OH:575-587).

HEAD: after OH:18 add `<script src="/html/_imageCropper.js" defer></script>`.

CSS:
- .onb-top (OH:43) gains `background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(28,28,30,.96) 60%, rgba(28,28,30,0)); padding: 22px 24px 18px; top:0; left:0; right:0`.
- .onb-step (OH:78-82) padding-top 96px.
- Remove `.onb-skip[disabled]{display:none}` (OH:51) in favour of opacity .4.
- Add .onb-back (44×44), radio card styles mirroring the phone cards, .pick-row/.pick-btn (min 44px) and .skel rows.

MARKUP:
- Header OH:338-341: `<button class="onb-back" id="onbBack" aria-label="Back" onclick="history.back()" style="visibility:hidden">←</button>` before the logo. Skip button text "Skip", on every step.
- Dots OH:343-349: 6 .dot elements plus "1 of 6".
- Step 1 OH:358-373: note → hello.note. Keep "Maybe later" (it calls confirmSkip).
- NEW step 2 (campus): title, Otto line by system, radio cards (role radiogroup; the card title is shortName, the sub is campusPickerSub OH:642; the tag 'from your school email' shows when id === ONB_BOOT.singleCampusId and is allowed; pill 'not open yet'), note, error p#onbCampusError role=alert, the Purdue link and inline switch panel (same rules and copy as B12), Continue.
- Step 3 (profile) = old step 2 fields (OH:386-448) minus the campus block (OH:404-411), with labels from ONB_COPY.profile and the handle status span. Continue only. Delete "Skip to resume" (OH:454).
- NEW step 4 (photo): circle preview, hidden input accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp", "Choose a photo"/"Skip for now"/"Uploading…"/"Change photo"/"Continue →", error line.
- NEW step 5 (clubs) and step 6 (people) containers plus the Finish button.
- Delete old steps 3-4 (OH:460-532).
- Skip overlay OH:537-546 becomes the two-variant sheet (identity variant has #skipName and #skipHandle inputs).

SCRIPT:
- Delete: TOTAL_STEPS 4 (OH:567) → 6; the legacy IU_CAMPUSES (OH:671-682) and legacy-select branch of populateCampuses (OH:725-737); IU_MAJORS (OH:781-802) and IU_SCHOOLS (OH:857-919) plus populateIuMajors/populateIuSchools (OH:850-854, 920-924) (majors come from window.vibeMajorsForCampus only); collectWorkExperience (OH:989-1004); the resume functions (OH:1090-1206); the Finish-time handle claim, profile body and welcome append (OH:1301-1444).
- Keep CAMPUS_ROWS / campusesForSystem / campusPickerSub (OH:595-651) as they are.
- `const ONB_COPY = Object.freeze({...})` with keys and values IDENTICAL to src/components/mobile/onboarding/onb-copy.ts. `PHOTO_ERROR_COPY` is identical to avatar-upload.ts:26-31.
- All server-provided strings (org names, handles, people names, majors, invited_by_name, error text) go in via textContent or createElement. NEVER innerHTML with server data. Image src is set only when the value starts with "/" or "https://".

DRAFT MIRROR (same contract as draft.ts):
- key 'vibe_onb_draft_v1:' + ONB_BOOT.userId, value {v:1, step, maxStep, fields, at}, TTL 14 days (expired or unreadable drafts are removed), field keys = ONBOARDING_DRAFT_FIELD_KEYS with the same types.
- 300ms debounced save on input/change; flush on visibilitychange→hidden and pagehide. Every storage touch in try/catch.
- Restore rules and resume step = the onboardingResumeStep logic, re-implemented. No draft in IS_REPLAY.
- clearDraft (remove the key) on Finish/Skip success.

NAVIGATION:
- goToStep(n) (OH:955-976): pushState({onbStep:n}) when moving forward; toggles .active; updateProgress; scrollTo top; no focus calls; #onbBack visibility hidden on step 1; disables back/skip while busy.
- On load, seed replaceState/pushState 1..startStep as on phone.
- popstate → the step from state, clamped, ignored while busy (re-push).

STEP ACTIONS (same requests, codes and copy as B12): campus save via onboarding-step; profile save via onboarding-step (handle check keeps the seq guard OH:1021-1046 because the static vibeRequest twin _persistence.js:259-296 drops `signal`; statuses per ONB_COPY).

Photo:
- `const blob = await window.openImageCropper(file, {aspect:1, shape:'circle', outputMaxSize:768, outputQuality:0.92, dismissOnBackdrop:false, onError: m => setPhotoError(m)})`. null → no-op.
- Preflight: size > 0 and ≤ 4*1024*1024, type in jpeg/png/webp (""/image/jpg → image/jpeg), else the PHOTO_ERROR_COPY line.
- FormData file = new File([blob], 'avatar.jpg', {type}) plus kind=avatar → window.vibeRequest('/api/me/profile-upload', {method:'POST', body: fd, quiet:true, failure: PHOTO_ERROR_COPY.uploadFailed}).
  * 413, or error 'Invalid file size' → tooBig. 'Unsupported file type' → wrongType. 401/429/terms_required → r.message plus toast action. Else uploadFailed.
- Then vibeRequest('/api/me/profile', {method:'PATCH', json:{avatar_url:url}, quiet:true, failure: uploadFailed}). Failure or an echoed profile.avatar_url !== url → uploadFailed.
- Replay: preview the object URL, no upload.

Clubs/people: the same endpoints, row rules, ordering (computed once), optimistic/rollback/error-code handling, sparse/empty/failed states (failed = message plus a Retry button), search over 8 rows, and Share (navigator.share then window.vibeCopy(origin, 'Link copied.')), as B12-social. Lists are cached in module state across Back/Continue and reset when the saved campus changes. Replay sends no writes.

Finish/Skip:
- window.vibeRequest('/api/me/onboarding-complete', {method:'POST', json:{v:2, otto_answers: buildOttoConfig(), skip?:true}, quiet:true, failure}).
- Success: clearDraft; try localStorage.setItem('vibe_tour_pending','campus'); vibeSave('vibe_otto_v1', ottoConfig) (keep OH:1397); triggerHyperdrive(() => window.__vibeTopNav(next)) with next = the safe relative data.next VERBATIM, fallback '/campus?welcome=1'.
- Skip goes to the server's next (fixes OH:1231's hard-coded /campus).
- The skip sheet's Skip is disabled while Finish is in flight. The Escape handler (OH:1241-1243) is ignored while busy.
- Replay: __vibeTopNav('/campus') with no writes.
acceptance: Extract every inline <script> without src and not type=application/json into the scratchpad; `node --check` passes on each.
rg -n 'Skip to resume|then your documents|photo, banner|IU_MAJORS|IU_SCHOOLS|wx-company|pfResumeUrl|Finish & open' public/html/onboarding.html → 0.

Copy parity: a scratchpad node script loads ONB_COPY from onb-copy.ts (strip-types plus the resolver hook) and evaluates the ONB_COPY literal extracted from onboarding.html. JSON.stringify of both is identical; PHOTO_ERROR_COPY likewise.
rg -n 'innerHTML' public/html/onboarding.html → only lines that assign static literals or '' (reviewer checks each hit).
Desktop 1280px screenshots of /onboarding/classic?replay=1, steps 1-6, with the non-GET fetch blocker installed first. The blocker record is empty after tapping every control including Finish.

With ONB_BOOT.system='purdue' simulated in DevTools on a scratch copy, the cards list Indianapolis (sub 'Purdue Indianapolis · one community with IU Indianapolis (formerly IUPUI)') then Fort Wayne then Purdue campuses; nothing preselected.
dependsOn: F1 and F2 live before push (same reason as B12-social)
